newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, Nov 25-Dec 1 - Bourgas - 53 Vessels in port operating of which 33 loading (5 chemicals, 2 copper, 2 zinc, 7 ammonium nitrate, 1 vegetable oil, 1 general cargo, 2 fazer, 6 steel, 1 cigarettes, 1 bentonite, 1 metals, 1 clinker, 1 cars, 2 benzene). 15 Discharging (2 sugar, 3 fish meal, 1 salt, 1 coal, 2 iron ore, 1 metal, 3 cars, 2 petrol). 4 Discharging/loading (2 containers, 1 equipment/metal, 1 salt/metal). 1 Vessel under repair, 11 waiting in roads of which 5 to load (2 chemicals, 1 gasoil, 1 timber, 1 vegetable oil). 4 To discharge (1 cars, 1 sugar, 1 iron ore, 1 general cargo), 2 awaiting orders. 12 Vessels due of which 5 to load (1 general cargo, 1 baryte concentrates, 1 cigarettes, 1 bentonite, 1 gasoil). 7 To discharge (1 wheat, 1 tobacco, 1 containers, 1 copper concentrate, 2 coal, 1 iron ore).

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik, Teps - 30 Vessels in port operating of which 16 loading (3 clinker, 1 kaolin, 3 ure 1 edc, 3 soda, 1 tsp, 1 wood materials, 1 quartz sand, 1 cement, 1 sas). 6 Discharging (1 apatite, 5 coal). 5 Discharging/loading containers, 3 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 4 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to discharge/load containers, 4 cargo not nominated. Dec 2 - Varna - Varna east - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 awaiting orders. Varna west - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Varna lesport, vaa tanker berth - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharg., 10 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 12 vessels due. Bourgas west - 2 Vessels discharging at berth. Tanker berth - 1 Vessel loading at berth. No labour problems at either port.

CROATIA, Dec 3 - Rijeka - Four vessels discharging at berth, 4loading at berth. 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 at inoperative berth, 2 anchored, 4 due. Split - One vessel loading at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - Two vessels loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Zadar, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Dec 3 - Limassol - Five container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 1 ro/ro discharging/loading at berth. 9 Vessels due 4/12 of which 5 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 3 passenger vessels. Larnaca - Two container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. 2 Vessels due 4/12 of which 1 containers, 1 conventional vessel.

ESTONIA, Dec 3 - No labour problems. Tallinn city port - 1 MAP vessel loading at berth, 1 sugar vessel discharging at berth, 4 vessels due. Kopli - 1 Sawn timber vessel loading at berth, 1 cocoa bean vessel discharging at berth, 8 vessels due. Muuga - 6 Vessels loading at berth (1 black oil, 1 paper, 2 fertiliser, 2 tractors). 6 Discharging at berth (4 grain, 1 benzene, 1 fish). Parnu - Eight vessels discharging at berth of which 3 peat, 5 timber, 1 vessel due.

ITALY, Dec 3 - Naples - One bulk carrier with etb 4/12. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 39 Vessels berthed, 6 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 4 vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 6 vessels berthed. 5 Vessels under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Seven vessels in roads, 41 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Salerno, Naples, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - Three vessels in roads, 2 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - One vessel in roads, no vessels berthed. Sarroch - Seven vessels in roads, 4 vessels berthed. Taranto - Seven vessels in roads. Ravenna - Seven vessels in roads. Venice - Two vessels in roads. Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays.

LATVIA, Dec 2 - No strikes at any port. Riga - Nineteen vessels in port, all operating, of which 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 cotton loaders, 1 tanker loader, 3 metal loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 2 fruit dischargers, 2 fish dischargers, 1 sugar discharger, 1 project cargo discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 14 vessels due. Ventspils - Four vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 mop loader, 2 steel loaders, 1 ferrous metal loader. No vessels waiting, no delays, 10 vessels due. Liepaja - Eight vessels in port of which 7 operating, 1 awaiting instructions, no delays, 3 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Dec 2 - Klaipeda - 16 Vessels loading of which 2 pellets, 7 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 3 timber, 1 steel coils, 1 oil, 1 preparations. 9 Vessels discharging of which 5 fish, 1 sugar, 1 oremulsion, 1 grain, 1 fish powder. 2 Vessels in roads, 39 due.

POLAND, Dec 3 - Szczecin - 61 Vessels loading at berth, 46 discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 10 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 113 due. Gdynia - 11 Vessels operating of which 4 general cargo loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth (1 bulker, 1 general cargo, 3 grain). 6 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 40 due. Gdansk - 15 Vessels operating, of which 9 loading at berth (2 coal, 4 general cargo, 3 bulkers). 6 Discharging at berth (3 grain, 2 general cargo, 1 bulker). 1 Vessel awaiting turn, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 15 due.

PORTUGAL, Dec 2 - Sines - Five vessels in port operating of which 3 discharging (1 crude oil, 1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha). 2 Loading (1 butadiene, 1 fuel oil). 1 Vessel waiting in port to load gasoil/gasoline/jet fuel. 6 Vessels due of which 2 to discharge (1 crude oil, 1 metallic structures). 4 To load (1 gasoil, 1 jet fuel, 1 ethylene, 1 butane/propane). Dec 3 - Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth. 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 10 due of which 6 to discharge, 2 to load, 2 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Dec 3 - Constantza - 42 Vessels operating of which 16 general cargo, 1 bagged cement (all loading). 15 Bulkers (7 loading, 8 discharging). 6 Bagged chemicals (5 loading, 1 discharging). 3 Tankers (1 loading, 2 discharging). 1 Container discharger. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 bulkers (2 to load, 1 to discharge). 4 Tankers to discharge, 1 general cargo vessel to load. Constantza south (Agigea) - 6 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - Three livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS, Dec 2 - St.Petersburg - Commercial port - 25 Vessels operating of which 16 loading (4 non-ferrous metals, 7 fertiliser, 2 containers, 1 equipment, 1 timber, 1 coal). 9 Discharging (4 frozen meat, 1 frozen fish, 1 beer on pallets, 1 dairy produce, 1 equipment, 1 oil cakes). 4 Vessels waiting, 21 due. Kaliningrad - No strikes. Five vessels in port, all operating, of which 1 aluminium loader, 1 cellulose loader, 1 grain loader, 1 ply-wood loader, 1 cocoa discharger. No vessels waiting, no delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - No strikes. Four vessels in port, all operating. No vessels waiting, no delays, 5 vessels due.

FAR EASTERN PORTS, Dec 3 - No delays/strikes/congestion. Vladivostok - Ten vessels in port of which 6 loading (1 general cargo, 1 timber, 4 metal), 4 waiting. Nakhodka - Eleven vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 metal, 1 general cargo, 3 timber), 4 waiting. Vostochny - Nine vessels in port of which 4 loading (1 coal, 1 timber, 1 wood-chips, 1 metal). 3 Discharging/loading containers, 2 waiting. Posyet - No vessels. Zarubino - Two metal loaders.

BLACK SEA PORTS, Dec 2 - Novorossiysk - Twelve vessels in port operating of which 4 loading (3 steel, 1 molasses). 8 Discharging (2 rice, 2 various, 2 citrus, 1 cellulose, 1 mandarins). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load steel coils, 3 to discharge (1 bulk sugar, 1 citrus, 1 luggage), 1 to discharge/load cars. 42 Vessels due of which 28 to load (3 scrap, 3 slabs, 10 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 1 pipes, 1 wire, 1 urea, 3 cellulose, 1 coal, 1 ferts, 1 pontoons, 1 seeds, 1 fresh pressed beet). 14 to discharge (2 sugar, 1 rice, 9 citrus, 1 aluminium, 1 roof tiles). Oil terminal, Dec 2 - 2 Tankers loading of which 1 crude, 1 diesel oil. 12 Tankers waiting to load of which 10 crude, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil. 4 Tankers due to load of which 3 crude, 1 fuel oil. TT berth no. 1 will be closed for repairs from 9-25/12.

NORTHERN BASIN, Dec 3 - Murmansk - 4 Vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 cabotage. No berthing delays. 13 Vessels due during the week of which 9 loaders (6 apatite, 1 coal, 1 npk, 1 non-ferrous metal). 4 Dischargers (1 alumina, 1 general cargo, 2 anode paste).

SLOVENIA, Dec 2 - Koper - Ten vessels berthed of which 1 container loader discharger, 2 bulk carriers to discharge coal/alumina, 1 bulk carrier loading grain, 2 car carriers to discharge cars, 1 livestock carrier loading bulls, 2 general cargo vessels to discharge granite blocks/rice, 1 naval vessel on courtesy visit. 13 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 2 car carriers to load/discharge cars, 3 bulk carriers to discharge coal/alumina, 2 livestock carriers to load bulls, 1 ferry to load/discharge, 3 container vessels to load/discharge, 1 reefer to discharge fruit, 1 general cargo vessel to load wire/cellulose. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Dec 2 - Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 coils, 1 iron ore). 3 Loading (2 steel products, 1 ammonium nitrate). Gijon - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 sugar, 1 steel products, 1 butane gas). 2 Discharging (1 fuel oil, 1 fertiliser). Stevedores strike still in force, with stoppages in the odd hours. Lbao - 22 Vessels operating of which 12 discharging, 8 loading, 2 loading/discharging, no delays. Dec 3 - Cadiz - 11 Vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros, 1 wood, 1 shipbuilding materials, 5 under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, Dec 2 - Iskenderun - One vessel anchored. Sariseki terminal - 2 Fertiliser dischargers. Yazicilar terminal - 1 Steel bar loader, 1 vessel at anchorage. Ekinciler terminal - 1 Scrap iron discharger. Isdemir terminal - 2 Coal dischargers, 1 vessel at anchorage. Toros terminal - 3 Vessels discharging of which 1 fertiliser, 1 acid, 1 soya bean seeds. Mersin - 25 Vessels operating of which 17 loading (1 flour, 1 general cargo, 3 citrus, 1 chrome, 1 barley, 2 oil, 1 sugar, 1 apples, 3 cement, 1 soda, 2 pulses). 4 Discharging (1 spirit, 1 oil, 1 sun flower seeds, 1 sugar). 4 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 3 containers). 15 Vessels at anchorage.

Dec 3 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 5 Vessels operating of which 3 containers, 1 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Mersin - 21 Vessels operating of which 12 loading (3 cement, 2 citrus, 1 apples, 1 general cargo, 1 vegetable oil, 2 legumes, 1 soda, 1 pumice stone). 4 Discharging (1 bulk sun flower oil, 1 paper, 1 containers, 1 lab). 4 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 3 containers). Free zone piers - 1 Vessel loading sugar, 1 discharging sugar. Seka - No vessels in port.

UKRAINE, Dec 2 - Mariupol - 11 Vessels loading at berth (3 fertiliser, 1 sulphur, 3 metal products, 2 coal, 1 sunflower meal, 1 containers). 1 Vessel discharging containers at berth. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (3 metal products, 1 sunflower, 1 lump sulphur. 2 Waiting at anchorage to discharge, both sunflower. 8 Floating storehouses of which 6 fertiliser, 1 sulphur, 1 metal products. 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked. 26 Due, 16 to load (9 metal products, 3 coal, 1 sulphur, 1 urea, 1 fertiliser, 1 grain), 9 to discharge (4 containers, 2 general cargo, 2 ore, 1 alumina). 1 To load/discharge containers. Kerch - Five vessels under repair/dry-docked, 1 waiting at anchorage to load metal products.

Berdyansk - Six vessels loading at berth (2 metal products, 1 sunmeal, 1 coal, 2 fertiliser). 2 Discharging at berth (oranges). 1 Waiting at anchorage to load fertiliser, 1 due to load metal products. Mariupol - Ten vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (3 fertiliser, 2 steel, 1 coal, 1 fodder). 2 Discharging/loading containers, 1 cargo not nominated. 7 Waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 D-bars, 3 sunflower, 1 steel, 1 slabs, 1 fertiliser. 26 Due of which 15 to load (3 coal, 6 steel, 3 fertiliser, 1 slabs/pipes, 1 steel plates, 1 barley, 1 fertiliser). 5 To discharge (2 equipment, 1 alumina, 1 fluorspar, 1 bauxite). 1 To discharge/load steel, 5 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 16 Vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (5 metal, 1 equipment, 1 sunflower). 4 Discharging (2 citrus, 1 meat, 1 wheat). 1 Discharging/loading containers. 2 Under repair, 1 passenger. 1 Waiting. 5 In roads of which 3 to load (1 sunflower 2 oil), 1 to discharge citrus. 1 waiting. 23 Due of which 13 to load (8 metal, 1 paper, 4 sunflower). 5 To discharge (2 citrus, 1 rice, 1 general cargo, 1 sunflower). 5 To discharge/load containers. Dec 3 - Odessa - Steel cargoes (loaders) 4 berthed, 6 due. Containers 2 berthed, 4 due. Grain (loaders) 1 berthed, 1 anchored, 7 due. Dischargers 1 berthed. Tankers (loaders) 2 anchored. General cargo 4 berthed, 3 due. Ilychevsk - Steel (loaders) 10 berthed, 3 anchored. General cargo 1 berthed.

YUGOSLAVIA, Dec 3 - Bar - Nine vessels berthed of which 1 discharging/loading containers. 4 Discharging (2 bananas, 1 fuel oil, 1 gasoline). 4 Loading (1 aluminium, 1 logs, 1 copper cathodes, 1 steel coils). 4 Ferries on lines. Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Trieste-Bar - No delays. Zelenika (Bijela) - Three vessels under repair.
